UK Mayor Proposes Repealing Alcohol Ban in Football Stands

Mayor Andy Burnham is advocating for the repeal of a four-decade-old ban on alcohol consumption in the stands at English soccer matches. Burnham argues the restrictions are outdated and unfairly discriminate against football fans. He is considering allowing fans to drink alcohol while watching matches on a trial basis.
